description: A pure CALCULATION node — force-directed layout of a graph: graph in, graph out. Draws nothing on canvas.
instructions:
A value-only node: it takes a GRAPH as JSON and returns a graph as JSON. It has no geometry input or output and draws nothing on the canvas.

INPUT: graph takes { "nodes": [{ "id", "x", "y" }, ...], "edges": [{ "from_node_id", "to_node_id" }, ...] } — coordinates in metres, local to the anchor. Wire Graph Geometry val-graph, or Skeleton val-branches, into valin-graph.

OUTPUT: val-graph publishes the result in the same shape — wire it into a Network node to draw it, or into another graph value node to chain.

Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).
